Minutes of a Called Meeting of the City Cancncil.
Austin, Texas, January 16, 1895.
Hon John Mc Donald, mayor, presiding.
Roll called.
Present- Aldermen Glues, Glascow, Garth, Haynes, Hume, Jackson Platt, Powell, Rudd,
Robertsons, Schneider, Taylor, Tobin, Townsend, Warmoth- 15.
Absent- Aldermen Anderson, Asmann, Fischer, Lawless, Linn, Nitschke, Shelby- 7.
The following call of the council and certificate thereto attached were then read:

Mayor's Office
Austin, Texas, January 16, 1845.
Mayors Call. To the Members of the Board of Aldermen of the City of Austin, Gentlemen- I
hereby call a special meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin to assemble in the
council chamber at the city hall on this day, January 16, 1845, at 6 oclock pm for the
purpose of making an appropriation to employ and defray expenses of attorneys to look
after the application of an injunction brought by the Penn Mutual and others which is now
pending at New Orleans La. Respectfully
John Mc Donald, mayor.
6.pm- Austin, Texas, January 16, 1845.
I hereby certify that the following aldermen have been served with the above call by
having it read to each of them in person, viz: Anderson, Asmann, Fischer, Glass, Glascow,
Garth, Haynes, Hume, Jackson, Lawless, Linn, Platt, Powell, Rudd, Robertsons, Schneider,
Shelby, Taylor, Tobin, Townsend and Warmoth, and that Alderman Nitschke was served by a
true copy having been left at his place of business, he being out of the city.
James E. Liney
City Marshal

App'g $1500 for The Mayor then laid before the council an ordinance fees & expenses
entitled "An ordinance appropriating the sum of $1500.00 attys in injunc- to pay fees and
expenses of attorneys in the matter of thetion suit. application for injunction by the
Penn Mutual Life Insurance Company et al. vs. City of Austin now pending at New Orleans."
The ordinance was read first time after which motions were made in the following order and
duly seconded: to suspend the rules and place the ordinance on its second and third
readings, and that it do now pass, each of which were adopted by the following vote: Yeas-
Aldermen Glass, Glascock, Garth, Haynes, Hume, Jackson, Platt, Powell, Rudd, Robertsons,
Schneider, Taylor, Tobin, Townsend, Warmoth- 15. On motion the council then adjourned.
Milton Morries City Clerk.
